svg.aria-label: RAVEN-KN workflow: optical, spectroscopic and GRB inputs build a kilonova candidate (GRB notices and neutrino alerts are stored and matched to a counterpart found up to 3 days later); treatment derives the merger-time window, distance and kilonova rate; with a GW alert these give a coincidence and a joint false-alarm rate; without one, a targeted PyCBC or PyGRB search runs only once the transient is confirmed as a kilonova (light curve, spectrum or classifier score) and is detectable.
svg.text: Fink live: ZTF KN, Rubin · ATLAS
sky position, t0 window, D_L, light curve
WITHOUT A GW ALERT: TARGETED SUB-THRESHOLD SEARCH
else: hold, re-assess on new data
